name: claude-codex-duo
description: Claude Code + OpenAI Codex working as a pair: blind cross-model PR review, structured adversarial debate, and evidence-only deep planning.

plugins.name: codex-pr-review
plugins.description: Two-model PR review: lead-reviewer agent and blind Codex review run concurrently, verification, one merge decision; optional Workflow fan-out.

plugins.name: codex-debate
plugins.description: Adversarial debate with Codex on any motion, with a claim ledger and a written ruling.

plugins.name: codex-deep-plan
plugins.description: Evidence-only deep planning for issues, PR comments, or a request, with a blind Codex second opinion and a bounded debate, ending in one reviewed PR plan, or an evidence-backed answer for a question.
